mapper.select: SELECT count(MESSAGE_MST_NO) AS cnt FROM ${msg_table} WHERE MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '00' AND SEND_TYPE_CD = '${msg_type}'
mapper.update: UPDATE ${msg_table} SET MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '01', MOD_DT = SYSTIMESTAMP, MOD_ID = #{mod_id} WHERE MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '00' AND SEND_TYPE_CD = '${msg_type}' AND ROWNUM <= 500
mapper.select: SELECT MESSAGE_MST_NO AS MSGID, 'PH' AS MSGTYPE, CASE WHEN SEND_TYPE_CD = 'M1' THEN 'S' WHEN SEND_TYPE_CD = 'M2' THEN 'L' WHEN SEND_TYPE_CD = '99' THEN 'S' WHEN SEND_TYPE_CD = 'MM' THEN 'S' ELSE 'L' END AS MSGKIND, MESSAGE_CONTENT AS MSG, MESSAGE_CONTENT AS MSGSMS, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO), 1, 4) IN ('0010','0070') THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO), 2) WHEN SUBSTR(TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO), 1, 4) IN ('0011','0019','0016','0017','0018') THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO), 2, 3) || DECODE(SUBSTR(TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO), 5, 1), '0', SUBSTR(TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO), 6), SUBSTR(TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO), 5)) WHEN SUBSTR(TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO), 1, 3) IN ('011','019','016','017','018') THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO), 1, 3) || DECODE(SUBSTR(TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO), 4, 1), '0', SUBSTR(TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO), 5), SUBSTR(TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO), 4)) ELSE TRIM(RECEIVER_PHONE_NO) END AS PHN, NVL(TRIM(SENDER_PHONE_NO),'1355') AS SENDER, BROF_CD AS PINVOICE, MESSAGE_TITLE AS MSGTITLE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REGDT, CASE WHEN ETRS_MTCD = '01' THEN '00000000000000' WHEN ETRS_MTCD = '02' THEN SEND_EXPECTED_DT || SEND_EXPECTED_TIME ELSE '00000000000000' END AS RESERVEDT, (SELECT SYSTEM_CD FROM TB_LINK_SYSTEM b WHERE b.SYSTEM_CD = a.SYSTEM_CD) AS SYSCD, CASE WHEN TO_DATE(SEND_EXPECTED_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') < TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN '0' ELSE '1' END AS DATEFLAG FROM ${msg_table} a WHERE SEND_TYPE_CD = '${msg_type}' AND MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '01'
mapper.update: update ${msg_table} set MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '02', SEND_DT = SYSTIMESTAMP, MOD_DT = SYSTIMESTAMP, MOD_ID = #{mod_id} where MESSAGE_STATUS_CD = '01' and SEND_TYPE_CD = '${msg_type}'
